annotations.description: A run of {{ $labels.source }} was closed as FAILED: a bad download, a safety limit, or too many attempts. The map keeps the last good import. The reason is in ingest.run.error.

model.expr: sum by (source) ((increase(placemap_ingest_runs_total{outcome="failed", job="placemap/ingest", deployment_environment!="benchmark"}[15m]) > 0) or (max_over_time(placemap_ingest_runs_total{outcome="failed", job="placemap/ingest", deployment_environment!="benchmark"}[15m]) > 0 unless max_over_time(placemap_ingest_runs_total{outcome="failed", job="placemap/ingest", deployment_environment!="benchmark"}[15m] offset 15m)))

annotations.description: Completing the run would have stored too many rejected rows (over 2%) or retired too many records (over 20%), so nothing was retired and the run failed. Check the source before re-running.

model.expr: sum by (source, limit) ((increase(placemap_ingest_limit_trips_total{job="placemap/ingest", deployment_environment!="benchmark"}[15m]) > 0) or (max_over_time(placemap_ingest_limit_trips_total{job="placemap/ingest", deployment_environment!="benchmark"}[15m]) > 0 unless max_over_time(placemap_ingest_limit_trips_total{job="placemap/ingest", deployment_environment!="benchmark"}[15m] offset 15m)))
